state: FROZEN BEFORE CODE OR FIRST WIDE DEV EXECUTION
goal: Large-first direct numerical knowledge/association writing, cold retention, composition and unseen inputs; shrink only after a failing largest tier.
scientific_scope: DEV fixture only, synthetic; original WSP101 FIT/TRANSFER/NOVEL/RESERVED untouched
random: SHA256 WSP101|WIDE|v1|domain|relation|purpose|index, signed big endian? NO: unsigned big endian. No global RNG.
relations: AFFINE-ODD: y=(a*x+k) modulo 2^bits with odd a
source: Each (domain,relation) exposes only eight observed (input,target) pairs; inputs 0,1, plus six SHA256-selected unique inputs >=2; generated relation family and coefficients evaluator-only.
heldout: 128 unique unseen inputs per rule plus 8192 two-hop compositions at max tier; fixed by hashed index not observed target; predictions and source receipts hashed before scorer reads truth.
direct_write: Infer public four-family operator from the eight pairs, write 3 numeric integer slots (opcode,coefficient,k) per relation; no gradients; no hidden generator parameter access. This is rule compilation, not AGI.
symbolic_control: Independent public-grammar operator fitting from same 8 examples; strongest valid control may tie, and a tie is not direct-write superiority.
retrieval_control: Exact dictionary memorization of eight observed pairs; abstains on missing unseen keys.
cold_retention: Freeze and restore numeric weight array after first half of relations; then add remaining relations, require prior associations unchanged; no capacity/overwrite collision inferred.
metrics: Exact source/heldout/composition accuracy, source-fit, source size and SHA, predicted label seals, model slots, cold memory receipts, whole-process CPU/wall, source/action reads. Compare entire pipelines.
cutoff: Top tier CPU-only bounded 180 seconds for experiment and 450s CI; if failure, diagnose then test smaller frozen tiers without changing algorithms. A failed tier must stay in record.
dev_pass: Recognize or reject underidentifiable source; >=99% unseen/2-hop accuracy from direct writer and strong symbolic; cold exact restore; no oracle leakage. This is ENGINEERING only, not scientific superiority.
dev_invalid: Wrong source/provenance, original worlds touched, strong control mismatched, hidden oracle data leaks, post-result tuning, fabricated end-to-end speedup.
important_limit: This synthetic rule-learning task supplies a small exact grammar to learner and control, so even perfect performance is NOT novel causal learning, AGI, or broad human knowledge.
real_corpus_next: Wikidata structured data CC0 snapshot under frozen provenance and independent property/composition splits; separately assess ConceptNet CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution/share-alike obligations. No external data silently ingested during this development run.
